ops.title: ccx-reparent-published handoff: stack move --onto a branch outside the gt stack
ops.body:
Lane ccx-reparent-published (brief /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/meta-desk-3/b/ccx-reparent-published.md), repo yasyf/cc-context, worktree /Users/yasyf/repos/claude/worktrees/cc-context/ccx-reparent-published (branch ccx-reparent-published from origin/main ce6e5292).

Mechanism (read from code, not run): runStackSubmit (internal/cli/stack.go:671) passes members=chain, the current gt stack. stack move --onto X calls runStackSubmit with parents [cur=X]. stackPlan (internal/cli/stackrebase.go:1320) replaces the computed members (which held X via stackMembers over the retargeted state) with o.members, so X never enters byName and the override at :1621 trips the refusal at :1625 with a misleading message (WasParent and gt parent both trunk). stack rebase --parent works because it passes members nil.

Fix plan: in the o.members block of stackPlan, prepend stackAncestry(retargeted, trunk, targets) for each override whose child is a member and whose parent is neither trunk nor a member. The target then rides as a non-moving branch, kept at its published head (stackMovingBranches); stackTrackAdopted adopts an untracked target before the drive; the publication finish re-records child->target (stackpublish.go:647). Dry-run plan line already prints "fix · onto other (was main)". Refusal without a target unchanged.

Tests planned: new internal/cli/stackmoveonto_test.go: native fixture with sibling roots other and fix on main, both pushed with open PRs; (1) stack move --onto other moves fix onto other's published head, other untouched, gt records fix on other; (2) --dry-run prints the re-parent, gt parent and origin unchanged; (3) stackPlan members [b] on a gt a->b chain with no --parent keeps the refusal.

Ship: open-pr express, ccx vcs merge <n> -R yasyf/cc-context --admin --match-head-commit <sha> once CI green; cci post --kind landed --pr <n> --lane ccx-reparent-published --to meta-desk-3,install-desk; SendMessage meta-desk-3 PR + merge sha. Never --kind done.
